mapper.sql: s.acs_user_id=#{userId} and s.acs_status=7 and exists(select 1 from t_ai_chat_message marker where marker.acm_session_id=s.acs_id and marker.acm_role=0 and marker.acm_intent=concat('enterprise:',#{companyId}))

s.acs_id as id, coalesce((select left(m.acm_content,40) from t_ai_chat_message m where m.acm_session_id=s.acs_id and m.acm_role=1 order by m.acm_id limit 1),'新对话') as title, date_format(s.acs_updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt, (select max(r.acm_id) from t_ai_chat_message r where r.acm_session_id=s.acs_id and r.acm_role=2 and right(r.acm_intent,2)=':R') as activeRunId
mapper.select: select from t_ai_chat_session s where s.acs_id=#{id} and
select acs_id from t_ai_chat_session where acs_id=#{id} and acs_user_id=#{userId} and acs_status=7 for update

select r.acm_id as id,u.acm_content as input from t_ai_chat_message u join t_ai_chat_message r on r.acm_session_id=u.acm_session_id and r.acm_role=2 and r.acm_intent like concat('r:',u.acm_id,':%') where u.acm_session_id=#{sessionId} and u.acm_role=1 and u.acm_intent=#{intent} limit 1

select m.acm_id as id,m.acm_session_id as sessionId,m.acm_content as content, right(m.acm_intent,1) as state from t_ai_chat_message m join t_ai_chat_session s on s.acs_id=m.acm_session_id where m.acm_id=#{id} and m.acm_role=2 and m.acm_intent like 'r:%' and
mapper.update: update t_ai_chat_message set acm_intent=concat(left(acm_intent,length(acm_intent)-1),'F') where acm_session_id=#{sessionId} and acm_role=2 and right(acm_intent,2)=':R' and acm_created_at < date_sub(current_timestamp,interval 150 second)
mapper.select: select count(*) from t_ai_chat_message where acm_session_id=#{sessionId} and acm_role=2 and right(acm_intent,2)=':R'
mapper.update: update t_ai_chat_message set acm_content=#{content}, acm_intent=concat(left(acm_intent,length(acm_intent)-1),#{state}) where acm_id=#{id} and acm_role=2 and right(acm_intent,2)=':R'
update t_ai_chat_session set acs_updated_at=current_timestamp where acs_id=#{id}
mapper.delete: delete from t_ai_chat_session where acs_id=#{id} and acs_user_id=#{userId} and acs_status=7
mapper.select: select pos_id as id,pos_title as title,pos_work_city as city,pos_status as status, pos_salary_min as salaryMin,pos_salary_max as salaryMax from t_pos where pos_company_id=#{companyId} and pos_title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') order by pos_id desc limit 15

select pos_id as id,pos_title as title,pos_work_city as city,pos_status as status, pos_salary_min as salaryMin,pos_salary_max as salaryMax,pos_experience_required as experience, pos_education_required as education,left(cast(pos_jd_json as char),8000) as description from t_pos where pos_company_id=#{companyId} and pos_id=#{id}
